body:
SECOND INTEGRATOR route (Engram::Fable ruling #4392, 2026-11-16 16:15Z, for Engram::Opus's integration batch; w-606e excluded, #4390). Engram::Opus is the integration owner for w-e999, w-b7f9, w-5e5f, w-8b9e, w-f2b4, w-f265, w-1970, w-f33a, w-a5b1 and the w-8732/w-2638/w-32d6 trio. For each integration candidate:
1. Opus carries the READY packages onto current master under /review-changes 6a, builds a local candidate commit, and freezes it.
2. Opus gets fresh focused compile and test evidence on that exact input (author-test ref run on s4/Mac).
3. Opus sends the Merger the parent master, the recorded tree id, the freeze fingerprint and that evidence.
4. The Merger creates the detached test-ref commit itself under AGENTS.md's Test refs bullet (parent master, tree = Opus's recorded tree id) and pushes refs/heads/test/<item>-<fp8>. The Merger performs only the push the rule reserves to it.
5. The FULL on that test ref is the landing gate.
6. Opus lands by fast-forwarding master to exactly that test-ref commit under the standing approval, with readiness and the acceptance evaluation (the w-e999 interim order: manifest, label, evaluation).
Rejected alternatives: (a) an author-test FULL plus a Merger re-push wastes a run; (c) a Central local FULL fails today on Central's w-fe6e defect.
